/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/nvcc -forward-unknown-to-host-compiler  "--generate-code=arch=compute_60,code=[compute_60,sm_60]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_61,code=[compute_61,sm_61]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_62,code=[compute_62,sm_62]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_70,code=[compute_70,sm_70]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_72,code=[compute_72,sm_72]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_75,code=[compute_75,sm_75]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_86,code=[compute_86,sm_86]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_89,code=[compute_89,sm_89]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_90,code=[compute_90,sm_90]" -Xcompiler=-fPIC -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets -shared -dlink --options-file CMakeFiles/tensorrt.dir/deviceObjects1.rsp -o CMakeFiles/tensorrt.dir/cmake_device_link.o --options-file CMakeFiles/tensorrt.dir/deviceLinkLibs.rsp
